title: A pyroptosis-related gene signature for the diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
authors: Wang, Yuting; Li, Jun; Yu, Zhongsu; Li, Shuyuan; Chen, Yuxia; Pan, Yun; Cheng, Liangping; Yu, Guangyuan
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于转录组数据构建急性胰腺炎焦亡相关基因诊断模型，虽涉及TF调控网络但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a severe inflammatory disorder in which pyroptosis-a pro-inflammatory form of programmed cell death-may contribute to pathogenesis. However, the complete transcriptional profile of pyroptosis-related genes (PRGs) in AP and their potential as diagnostic biomarkers remain underexplored. This study aimed to systematically characterize pyroptosis-associated transcriptional signatures and identify the reliable biomarkers for diagnostic purposes. Three transcriptomic datasets from murine AP models were integrated to identify pyroptosis-related differentially expressed genes (PRDEGs). Functional enrichment and immune cell infiltration analyses were conducted to elucidate the biological pathways and immune microenvironment alterations associated with these genes. mRNA-transcription factor (TF) and mRNA-microRNA (miRNA) regulatory networks were constructed to investigate underlying molecular interactions. Machine learning techniques, including support vector machine (SVM) and least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO), were applied for feature selection, leading to the identification of key diagnostic markers and the development of a logistic regression model. The regression model were then assessed using an independent cohort of human peripheral blood samples. Eleven PRDEGs were identified, with enrichment observed in processes such as cytoskeletal organization, cell-substrate adhesion, and critical inflammatory signaling pathways, including MAPK and NF-kappaB. Immune infiltration analysis revealed significant correlations between these PRDEGs and various immune cell subsets, particularly M1 macrophages, Treg cells, and monocytes. A four-gene diagnostic signature, comprising ANXA3, IQGAP1, RELA, and VTN, was established through SVM and LASSO analysis. In the independent human cohort, the fixed-coefficient four-gene model demonstrated reduced discrimination, which likely reflects interspecies and tissue-specific variations. However, after optimizing the model to exclude non-significant predictors, a refined two-gene signature (ANXA3 and IQGAP1) exhibited improved accuracy, with excellent calibration and clinical net benefit. This study offers a comprehensive transcriptomic analysis of the pyroptosis-mediated landscape and immune microenvironment in AP. An optimized two-gene signature, comprising ANXA3 and IQGAP1, was validated in a human cohort with superior accuracy, reflecting critical disruptions in inflammatory pathways and cytoskeletal organization. Notably, ANXA3 demonstrated potential for stratifying disease severity. Although these markers hold potential for molecular diagnosis, further prospective studies are essential to establish their clinical specificity and generalizability across diverse populations.
abstract_zh: 急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种严重的炎症性疾病，其中焦亡——一种促炎形式的程序性细胞死亡——可能参与其发病机制。然而，AP中焦亡相关基因（PRGs）的完整转录谱及其作为诊断生物标志物的潜力仍未充分探索。本研究旨在系统表征焦亡相关的转录特征，并识别可靠的诊断生物标志物。整合了来自小鼠AP模型的三个转录组数据集，以识别焦亡相关差异表达基因（PRDEGs）。进行了功能富集和免疫细胞浸润分析，以阐明与这些基因相关的生物学途径和免疫微环境变化。构建了mRNA-转录因子（TF）和mRNA-微小RNA（miRNA）调控网络，以研究潜在的分子相互作用。应用机器学习技术，包括支持向量机（SVM）和最小绝对收缩与选择算子（LASSO），进行特征选择，从而识别关键诊断标志物并开发逻辑回归模型。随后使用独立的人类外周血样本队列评估了回归模型。识别出十一个PRDEGs，富集于细胞骨架组织、细胞-基质粘附以及关键炎症信号通路（包括MAPK和NF-kappaB）等过程。免疫浸润分析显示，这些PRDEGs与多种免疫细胞亚群显著相关，特别是M1巨噬细胞、Treg细胞和单核细胞。通过SVM和LASSO分析，建立了一个包含ANXA3、IQGAP1、RELA和VTN的四基因诊断特征。在独立的人类队列中，固定系数的四基因模型显示出降低的区分能力，这可能反映了物种间和组织特异性的差异。然而，在优化模型以排除非显著预测因子后，一个精炼的两基因特征（ANXA3和IQGAP1）表现出更高的准确性，具有极佳的校准性和临床净收益。本研究提供了AP中焦亡介导景观和免疫微环境的全面转录组分析。一个优化的两基因特征，包含ANXA3和IQGAP1，在人类队列中得到了验证，具有优越的准确性，反映了炎症通路和细胞骨架组织中的关键破坏。值得注意的是，ANXA3显示出对疾病严重程度分层的潜力。尽管这些标志物具有分子诊断的潜力，但进一步的前瞻性研究对于确立其临床特异性和在不同人群中的普适性至关重要。
